background_incidence: Typhoid "endemic in South Asia," most common bacteremic illness in children in Pakistan; rates as high as 1000 cases/100,000 child-years reported from Karachi.
outbreak_frequency: Ceftriaxone resistance previously rare: only 4 cases (0.01%) of ceftriaxone-resistant S. Typhi in Pakistan 2012-2015 (retrospective AKU lab surveillance); <1% ceftriaxone-resistant 2009-2012/2009-2014 in Karachi. XDR outbreak: 101 cases, 30 Nov 2016-28 Mar 2017 (~4 months), 2 subdistricts (Latifabad, Qasimabad); largest ceftriaxone-resistant S. Typhi outbreak reported worldwide.
endemicity: Endemic in South Asia; Pakistan described as high-disease-burden country for typhoid/AMR.
notes: Epidemic curve cyclical/irregular with 2 peaks, suggesting common-source + propagated transmission via contaminated water (sewage-line clustering, non-functioning sludge plants). TCV mass-vaccination pilot (children 6mo-10y) started last week of Jan 2018 in Hyderabad.
